name: Heterogenous_Synthesis_Benchmark
description:
Heterogenous_Synthesis_Benchmark
	

This repository presents a diverse tabular data generation benchmark. We invite you to refer to our paper on arxiv to explore the mechanism behind our data diversity, which we called Distribution-Guided-Rule (DGR). Within this benchmark, you can experience how diverse preference data coverage combined with customized generation enhances post-training performance.
Additionally, Heterogenous_Synthesis_Benchmark includes a comprehensive toolkit for… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CurryOvO/Heterogenous_Synthesis_Benchmark.
evaluation_method: downstream task performance (e.g., model accuracy on tasks trained with synthetic data) and statistical similarity/divergence metrics (e.g., KS test, KL/Wasserstein distances)
general_score_metric: downstream model performance (accuracy/F1) combined with distribution-similarity statistics (KS, Wasserstein, column-wise metrics)
reputation: Newer research benchmark and toolkit for tabular data synthesis; promising for synthetic-data research but not yet widely adopted as a community standard.
